description_full: Csquare, Inc. operates as a digital infrastructure platform that provides interconnection services. The company offers a geographically proximate, carrier-neutral colocation platform with pre-built power and cooling infrastructure. It also provides operating requirements solution, including the need for network proximity, consistent operating standards, and high service availability; and sub-5 MW colocation deployments within multi-customer interconnection-rich environments. The company serves enterprise, network, cloud, and technology customers. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Coppell, Texas. Csquare, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Dawn Topco L.P.

financial_summary: Csquare, Inc. is a mid-cap technology business with a $2.4B market cap on $987M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +123% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 0% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 43%.
The company is burning through $373M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 14.8× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 0.4× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 32.8% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and profit capture is only 0.4× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
